work_identified: Kanjur 'Dul ba Ka — Neyphug Monastery manuscript Kangyur, Vinaya vol. 1 (Ka), containing Mūlasarvāstivāda Vinayavastu chapters 1–5 complete and the opening of chapter 6 (Toh 1-1 through Toh 1-6 beginning in Degé numbering; folios 1.a–311.a of 'dul ba, ka). Neyphug is a distinct Bhutanese manuscript tradition (Bhutan, c. 1550–1900, 'Them spangs ma group') but carries the same canonical Vinayavastu text.
